description: This file defines FastAPI routes for handling legacy 'submissions' API endpoints in a backward compatibility wrapper. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving data asset submissions, with detailed documentation and deprecation warnings. The file manages interactions with various services related to data assets, validation, approval, and authentication, and outputs responses suitable for external clients. It also marks itself as deprecated and in the context of data asset handling, not a core 'source' code snippet like a library or algorithm.

methods.name: JSONResponse add_deprecation_header(response: JSONResponse)
methods.description: Adds HTTP headers to indicate the endpoint is deprecated and recommends alternative.

methods.name: create_submission( payload: Dict[str, Any], current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Legacy API endpoint for creating a data asset submission from a draft, triggering validation, and returning the created entity.

methods.name: get_submission( submission_id: str, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a submission/data asset by its ID, including validation status.

methods.name: trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Triggers validation run for a specified submission/data asset.

methods.name: approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of a data asset submission with optional signature and SoD verification.
